problem: Given that $‖7u+v‖=32$ and $‖v‖=4$, find the smallest possible value of $‖u‖.$

activity_context.topic_title: The Pythagorean Theorem and the Triangle Inequality

feedback.problem: Given that $‖u+5v‖=19$ and $‖u‖=4$, find the smallest possible value of $‖v‖.$
feedback.worked_solution:
Using the triangle inequality, we have that

$$
\begin{aligned}‖u+5v‖ & \le ‖u‖+‖5v‖.\end{aligned}
$$

Simplifying and substituting in the given information, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}‖u+5v‖ & \le ‖u‖+5‖v‖ \\ 19 & \le 4+5‖v‖ \\ 15 & \le 5‖v‖ \\ 3 & \le ‖v‖.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the smallest possible value of $‖v‖$ is $3.$
